title: Persistent Functional Self: complete reproducibility package for A Causal Theory of Persistent Functional Self in Embodied Artificial Agents
description: Executable Godot/Python reproducibility package, protocols, complete reference execution, independent recurrent-estimator comparison, parameter-sensitivity experiment, analysis scripts, provenance, and manuscript sources for the complete rerun of the persistent functional Self study. The repository uses mixed licensing: software under MIT, reference data under CC BY 4.0, and manuscript copyright retained by the author; see LICENSE.
